result.instructions: Tools for Quickbase, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the tables in our Quickbase app and the fields of the Orders table."; "Show the open support tickets from the Tickets table, sorted by priority."; "Run the 'Overdue invoices' report and summarize the rows.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quickbase data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quickbase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quickbase_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quickbase_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quickbase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quickbase_get_app
tools.title: Get an app
tools.description: Get the main properties of a Quickbase app, including its application variables. Quickbase API: GET /apps/{appId}.

tools.name: quickbase_get_app_roles
tools.title: Get app roles
tools.description: List the roles of a Quickbase app. Needs admin access to the app. Quickbase API: GET /apps/{appId}/roles.

tools.name: quickbase_list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List all tables in a Quickbase app, with their ids, names and record names. Good first call to find table ids. Quickbase API: GET /tables?appId=.

tools.name: quickbase_get_table
tools.title: Get a table
tools.description: Get the properties of one table in a Quickbase app. Quickbase API: GET /tables/{tableId}?appId=.

tools.name: quickbase_list_table_relationships
tools.title: List table relationships
tools.description: List the parent-child relationships of a table, with their definitions. Quickbase API: GET /tables/{tableId}/relationships.

tools.name: quickbase_list_fields
tools.title: List fields
tools.description: List all fields of a table with their ids, labels, types and properties. Use the field ids in record queries. Quickbase API: GET /fields?tableId=.

include_field_permissions.description: true = include the custom field permissions.

tools.name: quickbase_get_field
tools.title: Get a field
tools.description: Get one field of a table by its field id, including type-specific properties. Quickbase API: GET /fields/{fieldId}?tableId=.

include_field_permissions.description: true = include the custom field permissions.

tools.name: quickbase_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the reports of a table (their ids, names and types). Quickbase API: GET /reports?tableId=.

tools.name: quickbase_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: Get the definition of one report of a table. Quickbase API: GET /reports/{reportId}?tableId=.

report_id.description: The report id, unique to the table.

tools.name: quickbase_run_report
tools.title: Run a report
tools.description: Run a saved report and return its data (records for table reports, rows for summary reports). Quickbase pages the result: pass skip and top to read more. Quickbase API: POST /reports/{reportId}/run?tableId=.

report_id.description: The report id, unique to the table.

top.description: Maximum number of items to return (0 = Quickbase default).

tools.name: quickbase_query_records
tools.title: Query records
tools.description: Query records of a table with a Quickbase query (where clause, sort, group, select fields). Quickbase pages the result: pass skip and top to read more. Quickbase API: POST /records/query. Example where: {6.EX.'Open'}.

select.description: Field ids to return. Omit to return the default fields.

top.description: Maximum number of items to return (0 = Quickbase default).

tools.name: quickbase_run_formula
tools.title: Run a formula
tools.description: Evaluate a Quickbase formula against a table (optionally for one record) and return the value. Nothing is saved. Quickbase API: POST /formula/run.

table_id.description: The table id (dbid) the formula refers to.

tools.name: quickbase_get_users
tools.title: Get users
tools.description: Look up users of the account by email, or list the users of the account. Returns a nextPageToken when more pages exist. Quickbase API: POST /users.

next_page_token.description: The nextPageToken from the previous reply.

account_id.description: Account id. Omit for the first account of the token.

tools.name: quickbase_upsert_records
tools.title: Insert or update records
tools.description: Insert new records into a table, or update existing ones when mergeFieldId names a unique field (for example the key field). Writes live data: it changes records. Each data item maps field ids to values, e.g. [{"6": {"value": "Open"}}]. Quickbase API: POST /records.

table_id.description: The table id (dbid) to write to.

data.description: Records keyed by field id, e.g. [{"6": {"value": "Open"}}].

merge_field_id.description: Unique field id that decides update versus insert.

fields_to_return.description: Field ids to return for the written records.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Quickbase
prompts.description: What you can do with Quickbase here, with example requests to try.
